newsitem.title: USA: Ahmanson consent drive on Great Western OK'd.
newsitem.headline: Ahmanson consent drive on Great Western OK'd.

text.p: The Delaware Chancery Court has ruled that H.F. Ahmanson & Co can proceed with its plan to solicit consents from shareholders of Great Western Financial Corp supporting its $6.2 billion bid for Great Western, Ahmanson said Friday.
The ruling stemmed from a request by Great Western for a temporary restraining order against the consent solicitation, Ahmanson said.
The court reserved its ability to rule on the merits of Great Western's request, pending the outcome of the consent solicitation, Ahmanson said.
"We are pleased that the Great Western shareholders are geetting a say in the future of their company," Ahmanson said.
"Our merger proposal is in the best interests of the shareholders of both comnpanies, and we are committed to pursuing it," it added.
